class.name: JRPGCommandRegistry
class.brief_description: Which command class each command code stands for.
class.description: The built-in command classes register when the module starts; script commands join them. One instance of each class answers the metadata questions ([method get_metadata]), so the event editor and the server can know a command without making one.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns a new command of [param code] with its default parameters, or [code]null[/code] when no class has that code.

method.name: get_command_class
method.description: Returns the class registered under [param code], or an empty name.

method.name: get_metadata
method.description: Returns [code]{code, class, category, display_name, authority, usable_in, can_wait, id_parameters, child_lists}[/code] of [param code], or an empty dictionary.

method.name: has_command
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a class is registered under [param code].

method.name: refresh_script_commands
method.description: Forgets the script commands and finds them again in the project's global class list (after command scripts were added, renamed or removed); returns how many there are. It also runs once on its own, the first time a code is not known.

method.name: register_command
method.description: Registers the command class [param class_name] under the code its instances report. A class already under that code is replaced, with an error.

method.name: register_script_command
method.description: Registers [param script] (a script extending [JRPGEventCommand]) under the code its instances report; returns [code]false[/code] when it is not a command script.

method.name: unpack_command
method.description: Returns the command [param packed] stands for (as [method JRPGEventCommand.pack] writes it): a [JRPGUnknownCommand] holding it when its code is unknown (one warning per code), or [code]null[/code] (with an error) when the entry is not a command at all.

method.name: unregister_command
method.description: Forgets the class registered under [param code].
